headline: Indonesian Gold Prices Experience Decline In Mid-November Trading
metaDescription: Indonesian gold prices declined in mid-November 2026, with Antam and Pegadaian products recording lower market rates compared to earlier sessions.
aiSummaryBullets: Antam gold prices decreased by Rp7,000 to reach Rp2,515,000 per gram as of November 17, 2026.
Pegadaian reported simultaneous price reductions across three major gold brands in its Tuesday morning update.
Repurchase prices for gold have also experienced a decline alongside the drop in current market trading values.
aiContextParagraph: Gold trading in Indonesia has faced a downward trend during the second week of November 2026. Data from the state-owned pawnbroker Pegadaian indicates that major gold brands, including Galeri24, Antam, and UBS, have seen their prices decline simultaneously. Specifically, the price for Antam gold dropped by Rp7,000 on November 17, bringing the cost per gram to Rp2,515,000. This follows a broader trend observed earlier in the month, where price drops were also recorded by major outlets on November 7. Analysts have noted that these market movements in precious metals coincide with broader economic shifts, including fluctuations in global oil prices and updates regarding the national debt status as of the third quarter of 2026. Investors and consumers are currently monitoring these consistent price adjustments across various gold sizes and categories.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to coverage by five independent media outlets and significant public search interest, reflecting heightened consumer attention to precious metal price shifts.
